يحتقن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِنُ (yaḥtaqinu) /jaħ.ta.qi.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# يَحْتَقِنَّ (yaḥtaqinna) /jaħ.ta.qin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# يُحْتَقَنُ (yuḥtaqanu) /juħ.ta.qa.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
